_comment: Every skip in CI must match one of these. `max` is the most skips of that kind CI should show; a new reason or a higher count is reported (and fails with --strict). Update deliberately, with the reason.

allowed.name: private answer keys
allowed.why: answer keys are private by design

allowed.name: model runtime
allowed.why: needs a local LLM; run via model-eval.yml

allowed.name: pgvector not reachable
allowed.why: CI provides pgvector; any skip here is a regression

allowed.name: postgres unavailable
allowed.why: CI provides PostgreSQL; any skip here is a regression
